name: MetaMonster SEO – AI-Powered Metadata Optimization
author: Austin Price

sections.installation:
1. Install this plugin
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to \”MetaMonster SEO\” in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Enter your MetaMonster SEO API key and save the settings
  5. Configure your integration in the MetaMonster app and publish optimizations
sections.faq:
Is this a standalone plugin?

While you can use the MetaMonster SEO plugin as a way to edit metadata on your WordPress site, the real value is integrating with the core MetaMonster app. This lets you publish AI-generated optimizations directly to your site.

What if I have Yoast, Rank Math or another SEO plugin installed?

MetaMonster SEO works great with Yoast, Rank Math, All In One SEO and The SEO Framework! When one of these plugins is activated on your site, publishing from MetaMonster will update the content managed by the plugin.

sections.description:
Fix missing metadata in minutes instead of months. MetaMonster’s WordPress plugin helps you generate and manage SEO-optimized page titles and meta descriptions with the power of AI.

MetaMonster SEO – AI-Powered Metadata Optimization

Fix missing metadata in minutes instead of months. MetaMonster‘s WordPress plugin helps you generate and manage SEO-optimized page titles and meta descriptions with the power of AI.

🚀 What MetaMonster Does

Ever spent weeks fixing missing or broken metadata for a client’s WordPress site? MetaMonster turns that months-long process into minutes. Our plugin seamlessly connects your WordPress site to MetaMonster’s AI-powered optimization engine, giving you both free manual controls and powerful automated features.

✨ Key Features

  • Free Manual Metadata Control: Set custom page titles and meta descriptions for any page
  • AI-Powered Generation: Generate click-worthy metadata instantly with your MetaMonster account
  • Bulk Optimization: Fix missing metadata across your entire site in one go
  • SEO Best Practices: All generated metadata follows current SEO guidelines

💪 Perfect For

  • SEO Agencies managing multiple client sites
  • Freelance SEO consultants
  • WordPress site owners who want better search results
  • Content creators looking to save time on SEO

🔄 How It Works

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Set metadata manually (free forever)
  3. Connect your MetaMonster account for AI features
  4. Generate optimized metadata with one click
  5. Review and publish directly to WordPress

🆓 Getting Started

The basic plugin is free and lets you manually manage all your metadata. For AI-powered generation and bulk optimization, sign up for a MetaMonster account at metamonster.ai. Ready to stop wasting time on metadata optimization? Install MetaMonster now and turn hours of work into minutes.

SEO Plugin Compatibility

MetaMonster works with other leading SEO plugins, including:

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math SEO
  • All in One SEO Pack
  • The SEO Framework

If you have one of these plugins installed, MetaMonster automatically detects and updates the appropriate fields when you publish optimizations.

Built by SEOs for SEOs. Questions? Contact our support team at support@metamonster.ai
